name: Vorpal Executioner
description: A wickedly sharp saw blade descends and travels along grooves in a complex path throughout the room, attempting to decapitate everyone within.
disable: DC 41 Thievery check (expert) at four different junctions to jam all the saw blade's possible paths, preventing it from traveling through the room
reset: The trap resets over the course of the round and can be triggered again 1 round later.

offensiveAbilities.name: Total Decapitation
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature attempts to exit the room.

Effect The saw blade travels along its path, making one Strike against each creature in the room, twisting and varying its height for a maximum chance of beheading its targets.

offensiveAbilities.name: Decapitation
offensiveAbilities.description: On a critical hit, a target must succeed at a DC 39 Fortitude save or be decapitated, dying instantly unless it can survive without a head.

offensiveAbilities.name: No MAP
offensiveAbilities.description: The saw blade Strikes do not apply a MAP.
